note: No font_file/sacha_font_file here on purpose -- Italian only needs standard Latin + accented characters (à è é ì ò ù), which the STOCK Albertus MT already covers natively (it's what EA's own original European localizations shipped with). apply_localization.py treats both as optional; this language just doesn't need any font replaced. Sourced from the official vanilla Italian CSF (lang\italian.big) merged with 2.22-accurate English via bfme1_localization.json -- vanilla 2.22 has NO real updated Italian translation (confirmed: stale pre-2.22 balance numbers, unpatched Version:Format2 placeholder), so ~506 labels 2.22 added/changed were translated fresh for this file rather than pulled from the base game.
str_only_namespaces_note: label prefixes that do NOT fall back to CSF when data\lotr.str exists but is missing that label. Currently only relevant if a partial .str is ever shipped again -- the standard apply path deletes data\lotr.str entirely, so this list is informational only.
